title: Bad Hair Day
description: A glam salon for terrible hair and bare faces. Style the hair first — brush out the tangles, snip, blow in volume, curl, dye and clip — then move to the mirror for eyeshadow, lashes, blush, lipstick and glow, and finish with a score.

title: City Chaos
description: A 3D physics sandbox in a living city. Walk it, drive it, blow it up: spawn anything, weld your own structures and topple skyscrapers floor by floor with real debris.

title: Flappy Bird
description: Classic arcade bird game with custom skins and worlds shop.

title: Knockout Night
description: 3D boxing with combos, parry, super and online 1v1 with friends.

title: Battleship
description: 3D top-down battleship. Drag your ships into place, then sink the enemy fleet vs the computer or online with a friend.

title: Stratego
description: 3D Stratego with hidden ranks, spies, miners and bombs. Deploy forty pieces, capture the flag, or play online with a friend.

title: Catan
description: 3D Catan on a full island: settle, trade with the bank or your rivals, build roads and cities, and race three computer players to ten points.

title: Chess
description: 3D chess on a wooden set. Play the computer, or invite a friend with a code and play live.

title: Star Clicker
description: Click your star, grow it and add orbiting planets.

title: Verity Clicker
description: Click On Verity

title: Hedgerow Hallow
description: Guard the veggie patch from snails, beetles and one very rude badger.

title: Wildwood
description: Hand-drawn 2D survival. Gather, hunt, fish and rub materials on the crafting mat to raise a fire, a workbench and a rescue beacon before the nights get you.

title: Wildwood 3D
description: The island in low-poly 3D. Command a crew of settlers to fell the fir woods, break stone and raise a village of huts, while you hunt, fish and keep the fires alive long enough to light the rescue beacon.

title: Secret Room
description: A cozy bedroom studio. Place, rotate and resize sixty pieces of furniture, paint the walls, change the light, then share the room, visit other players' bedrooms and enter the weekly competition.

title: Outfit Battle
description: A live runway fashion game. Style a look from eighty-plus pieces in two minutes, walk the runway against up to seven stylists, vote for the room and climb the global board.

title: Pet Café
description: Run a cosy café for adorable animals. Take orders, cook every dish to order, collect thirty-six wandering pets, place and paint a café of your own, then visit real players' cafés, leave hearts and enter the weekly decoration competition.

title: Last Stand
description: An eighteen-round neon battle royale of microgames. Everyone plays the same reflex, timing, memory and aim challenges at once, the worst performances drop out, and the last player standing takes the crown. Accounts, ranks, daily quests and cosmetics included.

title: Bake Off!
description: A live 3D baking competition for two to eight players. Get a mystery theme, weigh and mix for real, time your bake, then frost, pipe, top and write on a cake everyone can see — and vote on. Coins, levels, a shop, daily challenges and a global board included.

title: Dream Park
description: Build a 3D amusement park from an empty field: thirty working rides, a rollercoaster track workshop, paths, shops and scenery, then open the gates to animated guests who queue, ride, eat and spend. Hire staff, set prices, research, expand and visit other keepers' saved parks.

title: Little Town
description: Build a cosy 3D village from a single cottage and a cobbled lane: ninety buildings and decorations, winding roads and riverside paths, animated neighbours with jobs and happiness, daily quests and seasons — then visit other mayors' towns, swap likes and enter the weekly contest.
